integrity: Original weighted-torus tree product and general determinant-design techniques are explicitly credited as known. Analytic proof and a finite standard-library checker are provided. Numerical checks do not replace infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Square tori C_n by C_n with n>=3, linear prices constant within the two coordinate edge classes, fixed positive budget; no higher-dimensional, rectangular, or arbitrary-price claim. Singular limit is pointwise for each fixed kappa>0. Originality has residual literature risk.
title: A linear-price crossover in D-optimal conductance allocation on square tori
